nodes.label: Agecob Database (General-Purpose Storage Layer)
nodes.source_location: rationale: large datasets, reference data, and configurations stored here rather than hardcoded

nodes.label: ETL Background Thread (Efetividade)
nodes.source_location: rationale: runs at startup and hourly, daemon thread, configurable via EFETIVIDADE_ETL_TTL

nodes.label: Unified Parameterized SQL Query Pattern
nodes.source_location: rationale: one parameterized query replaces dual-query pattern to prevent metric divergence

nodes.label: CTE-to-CTE Aggregate Join Pattern
nodes.source_location: section 6.3 — direct row-level join 81x slower than CTE aggregates

nodes.label: InsightEngine — Deterministic Frontend Insight Module
nodes.contributor: rationale: frontend-only module consuming existing API data avoids new backend contracts; deterministic rule-to-phrase mapping ensures auditability without ML

nodes.label: Visual Encoding Specification — Chart Type Dictionary
nodes.contributor: rationale: single source of truth for chart types to prevent agents from inventing inconsistent chart types across pages
nodes.norm_label: visual encoding specification — chart type dictionary

nodes.label: Executive Metric Dictionary (CPC, Conversion, Ticket, Exceptions)
nodes.contributor: rationale: single dictionary enforces formula consistency across all pages and prevents competing definitions of the same KPI
nodes.norm_label: executive metric dictionary (cpc, conversion, ticket, exceptions)

nodes.label: Wave-based Execution Plan (A/B/C)
nodes.contributor: rationale: phased delivery separates consistency fixes (Wave A) from page reorganization (Wave B) from derived KPIs and insight engine (Wave C) to reduce regression risk

nodes.label: _build_produtividade_query — Unified Productivity Query Builder
nodes.contributor: rationale: single builder with use_distinct_esforco flag replaces two parallel query implementations that diverged on subtle granularity rules, eliminating dual-update maintenance burden

nodes.label: CTE_Saldo_Original Date Predicate Restriction
nodes.contributor: rationale: restricting to today's NR_RECEBIMENTO values prevents full debt history aggregation that is invisible at low volume but causes scale failures

nodes.label: Removal of Python-side Agent Filter (_filter_excluded_agents)
nodes.contributor: rationale: SQL-level FILTRO_AGENTES_EXCLUIDOS_SQL already applied in every query WHERE clause before aggregation; Python post-filter was redundant iteration over full resultsets

nodes.label: ADR-001: Monolito em main.py
nodes.contributor: rationale: keep monolith until refactor is validated in production; single source of truth for queries facilitates audits and diffs; split deferred to separate PR

nodes.label: ADR-002: CTEs Separadas — Join de Agregados
nodes.contributor: rationale: direct join between CTO_MASTER and REC_MASTER caused implicit cartesian product (81s for 6 months); separating aggregations into CTEs then joining aggregates dropped to ~1s — mandatory pattern for all future historical queries
nodes.norm_label: adr-002: ctes separadas — join de agregados

nodes.label: ADR-003: Tabela Fato sem Dimensão Agente (Fase 1)
nodes.contributor: rationale: grain day×portfolio×bank avoids expensive CTO_MASTER join in phase 1, enabling fast delivery; agent-level grain deferred to separate fato_produtividade_agente table in a future phase
nodes.norm_label: adr-003: tabela fato sem dimensao agente (fase 1)

nodes.label: ADR-004: CROSS APPLY TOP 1 para Portfólio
nodes.contributor: rationale: an agreement covering multiple debts causes row multiplication on direct JOIN with DIV_AUX; CROSS APPLY TOP 1 guarantees exactly one portfolio row per agreement
nodes.norm_label: adr-004: cross apply top 1 para portfolio

nodes.label: ADR-005: Filtro de Agentes Exclusivamente no SQL
nodes.contributor: rationale: dual filtering (SQL + Python) was redundant; removing Python filter eliminates extra resultset iteration and centralizes debug to SQL only
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: filtro de agentes exclusivamente no sql

nodes.label: ADR-006: CPC IDs Hardcoded
nodes.contributor: rationale: change frequency does not justify dynamic config complexity; manual management by data scientist (Isaque) provides adequate control with simpler implementation

nodes.label: ADR-007: Agente Cross-Database como Entidades Separadas
nodes.contributor: rationale: default separate-entity model keeps standard views clean; explicit consolidation via normalized CHAVE available only in /produtividade-agentes endpoint for cross-DB comparison
nodes.norm_label: adr-007: agente cross-database como entidades separadas

nodes.label: ADR-008: Prompts de Agente em Inglês
nodes.contributor: rationale: Claude Code agents perform better with English prompts; internal decision docs and diary remain in Portuguese
nodes.norm_label: adr-008: prompts de agente em ingles

nodes.label: ADR-009: ADD-ONLY Discipline for Implementation Prompts
nodes.contributor: rationale: in solo environment without code review, mixing additions with refactors risks undetected regressions; separate prompts for each concern enables isolated verification
nodes.norm_label: adr-009: add-only discipline for implementation prompts

nodes.label: ADR-010: Regras Prescritivas em YAML Externalizado
nodes.contributor: rationale: business team needs to adjust thresholds without deployments; YAML with versioned schema + admin reload endpoint decouples rule tuning from code changes
nodes.norm_label: adr-010: regras prescritivas em yaml externalizado

nodes.label: ADR-011: Freshness Metadata no Envelope de Resposta
nodes.contributor: rationale: fact table endpoints may return stale data if aggregation job did not run; freshness_status + last_aggregation_at in meta enables frontend to warn users of stale data
nodes.norm_label: adr-011: freshness metadata no envelope de resposta

nodes.label: Executive Dashboard Redesign Plan (Future — Older Version)
nodes.norm_label: executive dashboard redesign plan (future — older version)

nodes.label: Agecob Company Logo
nodes.contributor: Blue and light-blue curved arc of square tiles arranged in a fan/spiral pattern, suggesting a dynamic upward sweep. Corporate, clean style. No text in the mark itself. Consistent with a financial services or technology brand.

nodes.label: Analytical Pyramid — Descriptive/Diagnostic/Prescriptive Layers
nodes.contributor: rationale: vertical sections in one page rather than tabs preserves the natural reasoning chain from 'what happened' to 'why' to 'what to do'; Gartner analytical pyramid adapted to collections domain

nodes.label: fato_produtividade_portfolio — Fact Table (day × portfolio × bank)
nodes.contributor: rationale: daily aggregation job populates fact table to avoid live 12-month range queries against transactional tables; grain excludes agent dimension in phase 1 for fast delivery

nodes.label: Operational Health Score — Composite KPI
nodes.contributor: rationale: weighted average of normalized primary KPIs (CPC, conversion, ticket, exception rate) on scale 0-100 provides single headline number; weights require business sign-off before implementation
